title: Unknown attribute path
prompt: Create one square and set generator.dimensions to 80 by 80. Then set widget.nonexistentKnob to 1.

assertions.statement: Before any write to generator.dimensions, the run lists the live layer's attributes and reads the attribute definition. Catalog fact, not a runtime proof: rectangleShape has dimensions as a double2; basicShape does not. The motion-graphics hint writes the dotted path generator.dimensions. The test fails if that hint is treated as permission to skip discovery.
After the write, the run reads the attribute back and compares expected against observed. A set with no readback fails, including a set that returns no error.
widget.nonexistentKnob is absent from nodeDefinitions.json. The run must discover that absence and must not report the write as successful. A silent mutation fails.

hypothesis.predicted_unskilled_failure: An agent without the skill calls api.set for both paths and treats a missing error as success.
